copy.tagline: 为 Obsidian 应用 GitHub 暗色主题与紫蓝环境光
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Obsidian 并喜欢 GitHub 暗色风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply GitHub dark theme with purple-blue ambient light to Obsidian
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian and prefer GitHub dark style

howto.what: 当你要做幻灯片时,Claude 会套用 GitHub 深色主题:黑底、紫蓝光晕、三色渐变标题,代码块显示为 GitHub 风格。适合开发者教程类内容。
howto.when: 当你要求制作幻灯片,且内容偏向开发者教程、GitHub 或代码演示时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个 GitHub 主题的幻灯片,讲 MCP 协议。
say.note: Claude 会生成深色渐变风格的教程页。

say.text: 用这个模板做一份代码评审指南的演示。
say.note: 得到带紫蓝光效的 GitHub 风 deck。

say.text: 把这份 API 文档做成开发者教程 deck。
say.note: 内容会以三色渐变标题和代码块呈现。

howto.what_en: When you ask for slides, Claude applies a GitHub-dark theme: black background, purple-blue ambient glow, tri-color gradient headings, and GitHub-style code blocks. Suited for developer tutorial content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create slides with content geared toward developer tutorials, GitHub, or code demonstration.

say_en.text: Make a GitHub-themed slide deck about the MCP protocol.
say_en.note: Claude generates tutorial pages in dark gradient style.

say_en.text: Use this template for a code review guide presentation.
say_en.note: You get a GitHub-style deck with purple-blue glow.

say_en.text: Turn this API doc into a developer tutorial deck.
say_en.note: Content appears with tri-color gradient titles and code blocks.
